scenes.title: Intro: robots in everyday life
scenes.educationalObjective: Explain intro: robots in everyday life to a complete beginner
scenes.narration: A robot is a machine that can sense the world, process information, and act. Robots come in many shapes, not just humanoid ones.

scenes.title: Meet the robot body
scenes.educationalObjective: Explain meet the robot body to a complete beginner
scenes.narration: A robot combines physical parts: a structure, sensors, actuators, a power source, and a controller. Each part has a different job.

scenes.title: Sensors: noticing the world
scenes.educationalObjective: Explain sensors: noticing the world to a complete beginner
scenes.narration: A distance sensor measures how far away an object is. It provides a measurement the controller can use to react to nearby obstacles.

scenes.title: Controller: deciding what to do
scenes.educationalObjective: Explain controller: deciding what to do to a complete beginner
scenes.narration: A controller receives sensor readings and follows instructions. For example, if an obstacle is too close, the robot can stop and turn.

scenes.title: Actuators: moving parts
scenes.educationalObjective: Explain actuators: moving parts to a complete beginner
scenes.narration: Motors and actuators turn decisions into movement. Wheels roll, grippers close, and robotic joints rotate to new positions.

scenes.title: Obstacle avoidance demo
scenes.educationalObjective: Explain obstacle avoidance demo to a complete beginner
scenes.narration: Watch this simple mobile robot move forward, detect an obstacle, stop, turn, and continue along a clear path.

scenes.title: Recap and challenge
scenes.educationalObjective: Explain recap and challenge to a complete beginner
scenes.narration: A robot senses, decides, and acts. Next time, we will look more closely at the sensors that help robots understand their surroundings.
